note: Regenerated at runtime by the collector across every game it touches. It exists so the classifier can never claim to detect an event type that has not actually been observed.
consequence: Game 2023020001 had no review, so none appears in its vocabulary. Reviews ARE marked in the official play-by-play as stoppage reasons (see review_markers_observed_in_other_games), and the league publishes an official statement for every review (verified_facts F31), which pipeline/nhl_scoring/situation_room.py ingests. The 'video review' filter on the site is backed by those statements, not by this one-game vocabulary.

review_markers_observed_in_other_games.note: Reviews are not a typeDescKey; they are stoppage reasons (prefix 'chlg-' for coach's challenges, 'video-review' for Situation Room / referee reviews). See data/reference/verified_facts.json F30.
